name: What plumbing modifications are typically needed for knee clearance under a sink?

mainEntity.name: What plumbing modifications are typically needed for knee clearance under a sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Achieving proper knee clearance often requires relocating or redesigning plumbing components. The primary goal is to ensure all pipes, including supply lines and drains, are either concealed within the wall or positioned high enough and insulated to prevent contact and burns. Drain pipes typically need to be offset towards the back of the cabinet or wall to free up front space. Insulating hot water pipes is also a common modification to protect users from high temperatures. A professional contractor can assess your specific setup and recommend appropriate changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing modifications for knee clearance usually involve relocating drain pipes to the back, concealing supply lines in the wall, and insulating hot water pipes to prevent contact and burns.
